messages:
maria: Hey folks — quick prototype for the invite flow + org access steps. Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz (screenshot attached). Main ask: check SSO discoverability and roles matrix density. Quick thoughts?
aj: :eyes: Looks tidy. Two quick nits: primary CTA is too close to the role dropdown, feels like accidental clicks; contrast on the disabled 'Require SSO' label is low.
sophie: Agree on contrast. Also keyboard order is weird — tab sequence skips the visible SSO toggle (visually it's between role & submit but DOM order puts it after submit).
kevin: On the roles matrix: the inline 'Owner' badge clutters small widths. Could collapse it into a hover/tooltip or an overflow menu.
oliver: For audit log nav — when invite is sent, can the success toast include a 'View invite events' CTA? Right now the toast disappears and there's no quick path to audit entries.
maria: Good point. I like a toast CTA that links to the audit view filtered by the invite event. Also microcopy question: 'Require SSO for this user' vs 'Enforce SSO sign-in' — which reads clearer?
sophie: I prefer 'Require SSO for this account' — concise and clear. Add a help tooltip saying 'Enforce identity provider sign-in for access.'
aj: Accessibility note — SSO toggle should expose `aria-label="Require SSO for invited users"` and be a proper switch with `role="switch"` and `aria-checked` state. Also add focus outline for keyboard.
design-bot: Automated contrast check: disabled 'Require SSO' label = 3.8:1 (fails AA). Suggest darkening disabled label by ~8% or using semi-bold for disabled state.
kevin: :thumbsup: Can we reduce role row padding to 1.25rem under 720px to avoid wrapping the role name + badges? That keeps matrix compact on narrow screens.
maria: Action items: 1) bump disabled label contrast or change weight, 2) reorder DOM so SSO toggle tab order matches visual flow, 3) add toast CTA -> audit log with filter for invites, 4) compress role row padding on small viewports, 5) update microcopy to 'Require SSO for this account' + tooltip. I'll open the design PR with screenshots.
aj: If you can, add a small e2e check for focus order in the invite flow. I can pair on that test.
sophie: :raised_hands: I'll update tooltip copy and run VoiceOver quick pass once PR is up.
design-bot: Deploy note: design PR created (#1234), visual diffs pending.
maria: Thanks team — merging after design signoff. :rocket:
